question: zimmah is recorded with more than one father: jahath-2, shimei-8.
note: The Hebrew gives Gershom–Libni–Jahath–Zimmah in 1CH 6:20 and Gershom–Jahath–Shimei–Zimmah in 1CH 6:42–43. The supplied verses do not establish whether these differences reflect omitted generations or namesakes, so they do not justify changing the recorded relationships.
